### CVE-2018-8718
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-03-27 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 44843: Jenkins Mailer Plugin < 1.20 - Cross-Site Request Forgery (Send Email) (webapps/linux, 2018-06-05, verified=0)

Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the Mailer Plugin 1.20 for Jenkins 2.111 allows remote authenticated users to send unauthorized mail as an arbitrary user via a /descriptorByName/hudson.tasks.Mailer/sendTestMail request.

### CVE-2018-1000861
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-12-10 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-502 CWE-502 Deserialization of Untrusted Data
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2022-02-10, ransomware=Unknown — Jenkins Stapler Web Framework Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

A code execution vulnerability exists in the Stapler web framework used by Jenkins 2.153 and earlier, LTS 2.138.3 and earlier in stapler/core/src/main/java/org/kohsuke/stapler/MetaClass.java that allows attackers to invoke some methods on Java objects by accessing crafted URLs that were not intended to be invoked this way.

Affected:

### CVE-2018-1999002
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-07-23 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 46453: Jenkins Plugin Script Security 1.49/Declarative 1.3.4/Groovy 2.60 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/java, 2019-02-25, verified=0)

A arbitrary file read vulnerability exists in Jenkins 2.132 and earlier, 2.121.1 and earlier in the Stapler web framework's org/kohsuke/stapler/Stapler.java that allows attackers to send crafted HTTP requests returning the contents of any file on the Jenkins master file system that the Jenkins master has access to.

Affected:
